origin: Original project-authored detectors. IBAN factual formats derived from the attributed python-stdnum/SWIFT catalog; no third-party regex copied.

exploit.eval.v1.safe_alternative: json.loads or a restricted parser with an explicit operation allowlist

exploit.pickle.v1.safe_alternative: json.loads with validated schema; never deserialize untrusted pickle

exploit.shell.v1.safe_alternative: subprocess.run with an argument list, shell=False and executable allowlist

formats: 4 character groups separated by space or hyphen
pii.card.v1.validation: Luhn plus preceding payment context within 32 characters on the same line

pii.email.v1.validation: bounded Unicode email syntax; no deliverability verification

formats: 4 character groups separated by ASCII space or NBSP; final short group
pii.iban.v1.validation: pinned SWIFT release 101 length and BBAN structure, mod-97

formats: 2 then six groups of 4 separated by ASCII space or NBSP
pii.nrb.v1.validation: PL country BBAN structure and mod-97

formats: 6-5 digits separated by one ASCII space or hyphen
pii.pesel.v1.validation: PESEL checksum and real encoded Gregorian birth date, all five centuries

pii.regon.v1.validation: weighted mod-11; 14 digit form also validates its 9 digit prefix

secret.entropy.v1.validation: Shannon entropy >= 4 after token/credential/authorization label; generic UUID/hash values excluded

secret.jwt.v1.validation: three compact segments, base64url decoding, JSON header with alg; empty signature only for alg none

secret.password.v1.validation: credential assignments; excludes environment/code references and redaction marker

secret.pem.v1.validation: private-key PEM marker including incomplete PEM
